name: Randomised trial of conditioning electrical stimulation in proximal nerve injury with a motor endpoint

design.model: proximal ulnar or median transection repaired within two weeks
design.readout: intrinsic muscle force and motor unit number at 12 and 24 months; Tinel advance as a rate proxy

discriminates: A motor benefit at a proximal level would show the effect survives distance; Tinel-advance data would separate earlier onset from faster elongation.

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (Crossref/Europe PMC), checked 2026-09-14; no source opened at figure level
